title: DigitalHumanities MuseumProvenanceMerge

stats.done_summary: Successfully completed the Digital Humanities Museum Provenance Merge research task. Merged two museum export datasets (museum_export_a.csv and museum_export_b.csv) into a deduplicated catalog, extracted temporal information, analyzed distribution, and produced a comprehensive research report with visualizations. Key achievements: 1) Schema harmonization of different data structures, 2) Intelligent deduplication merging 2 records into 1 unique object, 3) Temporal extraction from unstructured text (200 BCE), 4) Statistical analysis and visualization, 5) Publication-quality report with methodology, results, and discussion.
